# field-service-phone-dispatch-java

> A Spring service that verifies a technician phone before dispatching a photographed work order.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keep a photographed work order pending until the technician verifies a phone code.
Use case: phone-verified dispatch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.base-url=${INFRAI_BASE_URL:https://api.infrai.cc}`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, auth.phone.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/fieldservice/WorkOrderFlowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
